description: Use as a SELLER to change the price and/or token amount of your own pending quote, for example to meet the buyer's counter. Returns the new terms. The buyer then accepts with bull_accept_quote. Works only while the quote is pending. Signed: the first call returns a message to sign; call again with the same arguments plus timestamp and signature.

address.description: Your wallet address (the buyer or seller). Required.

signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign of `message` from the previous response. Leave empty on the first call.

timestamp.description: From the previous bull_* response. Leave empty on the first call.

name: bull_revise_quote
